original_metadata.title: For every positive rank ell, the standard quadratic bosonic embedding of ell copies of level-minus-one affine sl2 in two level-minus-one-half affine sp(2ell) vacuum algebras has coset equal to the global-sign orbifold of the rank-ell Heisenberg vertex algebra
original_metadata.author: Drazen Adamovic; Ozren Perse
original_metadata.source_title: The Vertex Algebra M(1)+ and Certain Affine Vertex Algebras of Level -1
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The argument identifies the commutant for every rank through an explicit involution-adapted Weyl-mode embedding and a full Virasoro decomposition with negative integral Heisenberg charges. Its substantive exclusion of additional coset states combines positive vacuum grading with that charge decomposition, then restricts to the simultaneous global-sign even sector. The complete free-boson construction and arbitrary-rank coset identification exceed an isolated rank-one Wick-contraction exercise.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Full Theorem2, all positive ell, with precisely the quadratic embedding (9), is selected. Read Section4 Weyl modes, vacuum grading, explicit involution-adapted b modes and tensor even-sector embedding; all Section5 current generators, H(i), inner products -2delta_ij, full displayed Virasoro splitting, and Proposition1 positive-degree/integral-charge contradiction. Standard Feingold-Frenkel free-boson realizations and vertex-algebra/Sugawara foundations are published background in Sections2-4. The displayed quadratic currents and Virasoro vectors allow the author routine finite Wick contractions without a new unexpanded construction; the substantive no-extra-coset-state argument is supplied in full. The Heisenberg involution negates all ell generators simultaneously, rather than taking ell independent rank-one orbifolds. Rank-one Theorem3 is included on the statement page only as context and is not counted; type-C coset Theorem4, ordinary-module classification and later conformal branching are excluded.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem2 for ell>=1, over C, in the exact Section4-5 Weyl realization: U=L_(A1^(1))(-Lambda0) tensor-power ell is generated by the quadratic e(i),f(i),h(i) of(9) inside L_(C_ell^(1))(-Lambda0/2) tensor L_(C_ell^(1))(-Lambda0/2). Then Com(U,that tensor VOA)=M_h(1)^+, where h is spanned by the ell displayed H(i), pairing -2delta_ij, and plus means fixed points under the simultaneous global sign H(i)->-H(i). The precise embedding is part of the statement; no arbitrary embedding, positive-level rational coset or separate rank-one/type-C variant is asserted.
